# Scenario: nested project names (app / app_billing) do not share host secrets.
# README: host keys use TO_UPPER(name)__; APP_BILLING__TOKEN must not appear in app as BILLING_TOKEN.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: app and app_billing'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_app-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_app_billing-web

exists $HOME/infra/apps/app/.env
exists $HOME/infra/apps/app_billing/.env
grep '^TOKEN=app-secret$' $HOME/infra/apps/app/.env
! grep 'billing-secret' $HOME/infra/apps/app/.env
! grep 'BILLING_TOKEN' $HOME/infra/apps/app/.env
grep '^TOKEN=billing-secret$' $HOME/infra/apps/app_billing/.env
! grep 'app-secret' $HOME/infra/apps/app_billing/.env

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: app
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9981
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: app_billing
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9982
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/app/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    environment:
      TOKEN: ${TOKEN}
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=APP"]

-- git-repo/dev/app_billing/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    environment:
      TOKEN: ${TOKEN}
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=BILLING"]

-- .env --
APP__TOKEN=app-secret
APP_BILLING__TOKEN=billing-secret
